body: The sweep's record: for each 0.3.0 requirement in reach, the stand task or fixture that holds its case and the check that proves it, each witness pinned by its test function's name through the record's source map. A requirement with no such check gets a new one.
A new fixture check is a minimal fixture beside the stand, used only where the stand's tasks lack a case. It is one file and one test target per behaviour and runs in both layout modes.

Every integration witness runs inside the stand-repeat leg, which runs the stand checks three rounds, either by widening the leg's selection or through a stand check that carries the proof. A witness that cannot run there (a unit test, a dev-host instrument, a CI-only OS leg) is stated so.

The leg check's reach: membership in the stand-repeat leg is read from that leg's own body, not from the whole CI script. A target dropped from stand-repeat alone, while the a11y leg still names it, then fails the check. The named-target list covers all seventeen of the leg's named targets.

Requirements that are not behaviours of a screen (the complexity reading, the README and front page, the upstream take, the records, and the cross-OS legs) have their witnesses named as they stand, or the record states why none runs inside stand-repeat.
The coverage leg's per-crate floors hold at the chunk's end. Any floor raised or crate added is a CI gate change.
The agent-run counts of what run stand, run all and run session select are re-counted against 0.3.0's added test targets and corrected where they drifted.

Stderr stays content-free: the graph, actions and layout verbs, an acting call's caused answer, and the coverage role print no id, name, value, typed text or caused message on stderr at trace level. This is measured through the log sink's target allowlist and its redaction of text, value, html and attrs fields, including on closed-span lines.

Masks hold: a password's or a file input's value reads the masked value on every 0.3.0 answer that can carry a control's reading (graph, actions, layout, caused, a kept check, an explored path's check). A masked type stays the masked stand-in in a recording.
The UI graph carries no values. The actions verb and a screenshot change nothing. The sweep's proofs of these 0.3.0 readers act on that and read them through the one snapshot model.
Stand layout held: the stand's desktop-native surface (viewport, font, spacing, the screens' structure) still reads as stated after the bundled font, the select list and the isolated component.
v030-11's witness row names the witnesses of the layout verb on every carrier, not the in-process layout read alone.
The open select list's coverage is proven headless. Where a 0.3.0 requirement's case lives in the select list, its witness drives the list headless.
The sweep claims no cap. A witness it widens is recorded in that cap's notes at the wrap.

The five surviving document-config field-deletion mutants are killed by tests only, with no behaviour change, and only if the chunk takes them. The viewport and media-type deletions stay equivalent and missed.

Records re-counted as evidence only: the session_common reader count in the observability plan and slice s03's no-tests absence in the test plan are re-found and counted at HEAD. Escher-driver's test counts in the two stale leaf lines are stated as evidence and never hand-edited.

Escalation bound: an engine change for every document, a boundary widening (a new carrier, field or exit, or a driver answer that moves on every carrier) or a new gate direction is raised to the operator, never decided as a lean.
A reading the sweep measures and leaves unbuilt keeps an owner: a residual row or a CARRY on a later entry, placed at the wrap.

body_fields.convention: each new accessibility check is a Rust test asserting over the AccessKit tree and the snapshot model, with no browser-side or external a11y tool
each new stand or fixture check joins the stand checks repeated three rounds in the stand-repeat leg
each new stand or fixture check reads the expected roles and names from the shared expectation tables, stated once, never restated inline
each new accessibility check gates CI and fails the build when it fails

Keyboard key contracts and focus-order rules (range input keys, the cells grid and CRUD list keys, Tab order, keyboard activation): SC 2.1.1 and 2.4.3 re-assertion belongs to another entry, and the sweep changes no key or focus behaviour.

The platform adapter and feature-gating decisions (accesskit_xplat, accessibility default-on or off in the browser, no adapter on stand binaries, the Dioxus feature by name): no build feature or adapter changes.

The capability statement's hand-edited accessibility reach: the capability document and the README belong to another entry.
Cognitive accessibility rows (invalid state not by colour or class alone): no form validation or invalid-state display changes.

Engine event-path rules for select, checkbox and click walks (one write path for list choices, input then change events, a disabled control stopping the click walk, double-click timing): the chunk proves requirements and adds no event handling.

body: The headless stand: stand checks and fixtures run with no telemetry sink installed; a new fixture check is one file and one test target per behaviour, run in both layout modes.
The 0.3.0 driver answers graph, actions and layout and an acting call's caused field: each must print no id, name, value, typed text or caused message on stderr in a sink-installing binary.
The escher-session coverage role and its coverage line: the line stays on stdout and is never logged; the role's stderr carries no content at RUST_LOG=trace.

The sink-installing host and mcp roles are read at trace level by the stderr checks; the closed command and tool_call span lines they print must carry only their allowed fields (verb, counts, tool, ending), never call content.
The telemetry sink's content scrub: content-named span and event fields are redacted by field name on escher targets; the stderr measurement relies on that scrub over the 0.3.0 verbs.
Masking: a password's or a file input's value reads the masked value on every 0.3.0 answer able to carry a control's reading — graph, actions, layout, caused, a kept check, an explored path's check.
The recording file: a masked type call's typed text stays the masked stand-in in a recording, and kept check files hold no private data.
The stand's desktop-native layout surface (viewport, font, spacing, screen structure) still reads as stated after 0.3.0's bundled font, select list and isolated component.

The stand-repeat CI leg's selection: every integration witness the sweep names runs inside it, by the leg's selection widened or by a stand check carrying the proof; witnesses that cannot run there (unit test, dev-host instrument, CI-only OS leg) are stated so.

The sweep's leg check must read the stand-repeat leg's own body, not the whole leg script, so a target dropped from stand-repeat while another leg still names it is caught; its named-target list covers all seventeen.
The coverage leg's per-crate floors hold at the chunk's end; a floor raised or a crate added is a CI gate change decided at P4.

The agent-run harness: the counts it states of what run stand, all and session select are re-counted against 0.3.0's added targets and corrected; its events and log carry no captured output or user content, and raw output is never printed.
Empty-stderr checks unset RUST_LOG for the child they spawn, except where a check deliberately reads the sink at trace.
A log or stderr check that fails names a kind of leak and a count, never the leaked content itself.
The layout read opens no span, and the actions read changes nothing in the document: a stderr or mask witness over them must expect no span of their own and no document change.
The sweep's record names the witnesses of the in-process layout read on every carrier for v030-11, now verified.
No boundary widening: no new carrier, answer field, exit code or driver answer change on every carrier; any such need is raised as a founder's question, never decided here.
A reading the sweep measures and leaves unbuilt keeps an owner: a residual row or a carry on a later entry, placed at the wrap.

body_fields.convention: every new test or fixture check is silent — it prints nothing of the page, the answer or the captured stream on success
every new log or stderr check's failure message names a kind and a count, never the content it found
every new committed fixture or kept check holds no secrets or private data
every new check that spawns a sink-installing binary and expects an empty stderr unsets RUST_LOG unless it reads the sink at trace

body: The sweep's record of 0.3.0: one row per requirement v030-01 to v030-17 bar v030-15, naming the stand task or minimal fixture holding its case and the check proving it, pinned by the check's test function name through the sweep test's source map, as the 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 witness tables are; whether it is a third table or a file beside the sweep file is a P4 fork.
A requirement whose UI behaviour has no check gets a new stand check or a minimal fixture check beside the stand's tasks — the stand is the proof, a fixture only where the tasks lack a case.

Requirements that are no behaviour of a screen (the complexity reading, the README and front page, the upstream take, records by construction, v030-14's cross-OS matrix legs): the record names their witnesses as they stand, or states why none runs inside stand-repeat (a unit test, a dev-host instrument, a CI-only OS leg).

Every integration witness the record names runs inside the stand-repeat leg at the chunk's end — three rounds, zero failures — by the leg's selection widened or a stand check carrying the proof (a P4 fork); a target joining the leg keeps its other legs.

The sweep's leg check reads the stand-repeat leg's own body, not the whole leg script, so a target dropped from stand-repeat alone while the a11y leg still names it is caught; a11y leg membership stays as it is.
The sweep's list of stand-repeat's named targets widens from the first ten to all seventeen the leg names, and the sweep asserts its count.

v030-11's witness row names the layout verb's witnesses on every carrier (the session layout answer, the CLI and MCP layout reads) now v030-11 reads verified, no longer the in-process stand layout read alone.

The coverage leg's per-crate line coverage floors hold at the chunk's end (escher-driver at 97 %); a floor raised or a crate added (escher-telemetry, seven_guis) is a CI gate change and a P4 question; the coverage floor check's exit codes stand.

The agent-run contract's counts of what run stand, run all and run session select are re-counted against 0.3.0's added test targets and corrected where they drifted, in the driver and its unittest contract tests alike.

Stderr content-free: a sink-installing host and the mcp role running graph, actions, layout, an acting call's caused and the coverage role print no id, name, value, typed text or caused message on stderr at RUST_LOG=trace — only fixed words, counts, the command span and service.name; the check drains the host's output while it runs and reads silence on a host with a sink.

Masks held: a password's or a file input's value reads the masked value on every 0.3.0 answer that can carry a control's reading — graph, actions, layout, caused, a kept check and an explored path's check — and a masked type stays the masked stand-in in a recording; a typed password never leaves the instance.

Stand layout held: the stand's desktop-native surface — viewport, font, spacing and the screens' structure — still reads as stated after the bundled font, the select list and the component booted alone; layout assertions run in both layout modes on the bundled font.
The sweep re-proves and claims no cap: v030-15 stays the Cold-agent bar entry's; a witness the chunk widens is recorded in the cap's notes at the wrap.

Two unmoved records re-counted at HEAD as evidence, not edited by hand: the obs plan's count of session_common readers (29 stated against 31) and whether slice s03's no-tests absence in the test plan still holds now blitz-shell has a unit test; the correction is the wrap's amendment.

escher-driver's per-file test counts after the answer-writer split (json.rs 0 inline, its 9 tests in a fifth path-attributed test file) stated as evidence only; the two stale leaf lines are re-derived by the wrap's comparers, never by hand.

The five surviving make_doc_config field-deletion mutants (shell provider, HTML parser provider, font context, abort signal, style threading) are killed by tests only, no behaviour change, if P4 takes them; viewport and media type stay missed as equivalent; mutation runs on the dev host only.

The sweep file, already the one escher-written test file over 800 lines, may not grow unchecked: a split keeps each moved witness's pin by test function name readable through the source map, and a shared stand table or fixture stays in its one shared module.

No engine change for every document, no boundary widening (new carrier, field, exit or driver answer moving on every carrier) and no new gate direction is decided here — each is raised to the operator as a question.
A reading the sweep measures and leaves unbuilt keeps an owner — a residual row or a carry on a later entry, placed at the wrap.
The CI verdict on the last wrap commit is read at P3, never read as green while in progress; a CI job cancelled with no runner acquired is re-run, not fixed.

body_fields.convention: a new integration check is its own test target, one file per behaviour, in the one blitz-tests manifest target list
a new stand or fixture check runs in both layout modes on the bundled pinned font, never skipping without a font
a new check holds no sleep and no wall-clock read; time moves by the virtual clock
a new socket or command-line session check is unix-gated, owns its host and reaps it on failure
a new table-driven test asserts its row count, and its assertions print a row index, never an argument value
a new test is controlled red-before-green, its expected value pinned as a literal
test data is stated in code, shared fixture pages and stand tables once in a shared module that is no target
a new log-reading check counts the sink capture by target and finds no id, name or screen content in stand logs
